title: Foto Peculiar de Maleta desde Arriba: Tres Gatos Planeando Secretamente Unirse al Viaje
prompt: Top-down view, realistic style. A quirky yet heart-warming scene: inside the same suitcase, one half is tightly filled with three soft, fluffy orange tabby cats sitting neatly in a row, as if they've been packed and are secretly planning to join their owner on the trip. The other half contains neatly folded clothes and a laptop, creating a playful contrast. Soft lighting, a relaxed and cute atmosphere, and the cats' adorable, slightly clueless expressions complete the scene.
